subtitle: Lesson 24 · Private Connectivity: VPN & Dedicated Circuits

code:
Site-to-site VPN:   whole on-prem NETWORK  <-> cloud VNet/VPC
Point-to-site VPN:  one remote DEVICE       <-> cloud VNet/VPC

No on-prem VPN device needed at the user's location --
just a client app and valid credentials.
caption: The 'point' is the individual laptop. The 'site' is the cloud network it reaches.

code:
Without P2S: laptop -> office VPN -> office network -> cloud
             (extra latency, office network must be up)

With P2S:    laptop -> cloud VPN gateway -> private resource
             (direct, nothing else has to be reachable)
caption: A remote employee reaches private cloud resources without routing through the office first.
